results.title: Go Hungary
results.overview: Go Hungary is a personal film diary showing life in Hungary under Viktor Orbán’s rule, from the perspective of queer teenage twins Nati and Dorka. Anger, frustration, and the fatigue caused by the country’s political situation become the starting point for a story about the girls’ everyday lives. Together with the girls, we travel through places marked by omnipresent propaganda and look for safe spaces where freedom can be felt.  GO HUNGARY is part 2 of the diptych DON'T POLITICIZE : GO HUNGARY

results.title: Racing hearts
results.overview: Roger Rey raced alongside the great names of Formula 1. At eighty-four, his wife Marylou asks him to return to racing in honour of their late son. After a series of chaotic beginnings, Roger rediscovers the thrill of adrenaline when, without warning, Marylou is hospitalized and passes away. On her deathbed, she makes him promise to take part in a major European hill climb in her honour. At nearly ninety years old, Roger has nothing left to lose and sets out to challenge age, fear, and death.

results.title: Research
results.overview: Two students discuss cinema as they search for inspiration in a library, leading to a rather peculiar existential proposition.

results.title: MORPHISM
results.overview: Eleven-year-old Kaat visits the Stavros family for the first time; a peculiar family of scientists where everyone, including the dog, suffers from a horrible wasp allergy. Blown away by the family, Kaat pushes her own boundaries further and further as an experimental subject.

results.title: Fine Grass of the North
results.overview: Carol fulfills her mother's dream by getting into a college in the capital... she just didn't say which one.

Trapped in a run-down circus, actress @A is forced to watch another prisoner, @B, on a monitor. As vicious social media attacks against @A intensify her nightmare, @B desperately tries to communicate about a disturbing clown painting. Caught between reality and delusion, @A must unravel the connection between the two to fight for her sanity and survival.

results.title: Escape at Alcatraz
results.overview: When a covert black-ops contractor seizes Alcatraz, the CIA smuggles hardened agent Lt. Jack Callahan inside to extract whistleblower Anya Turner and her damning evidence before the mission spirals into a deadly fight for survival.

results.title: Die Zukunft ist Vergangenheit
results.overview: In March 2025, the Zurich cultural institution «Zukunft» was forced to close its doors for good. This prompted Stephan Schulz and Julian Kirchner to produce an independent, community-funded documentary. They document the final days of «Zuki» and the essence that made this gathering place so special.

results.title: Gardi Hutter - Da Zero
results.overview: After the global success of her legendary clown character "Hanna", Gardi Hutter has bravely decided against retirement and wants to reinvent herself once again. In the stage play "Zero", she embarks on the journey to new artistic shores and a new self.

results.title: Long Shot - A Filipino Curling Tale
results.original_title: Long Shot - A Filipino Curling Tale
results.overview: What began as a sporting experiment turned into a grand dream. Amorana founder Alan Frei and three top Swiss curlers of Filipino descent want to bring the Philippines to the Winter Olympics. In order to achieve this, they must not only compete against strong opponents, but also navigate the complexities of being caught between two countries and identities. In curling rinks far from major sporting stages, the team grows together and begins to believe in the seemingly impossible.

results.title: Fishing Aboot
results.overview: How bad can one be at fishing? Very.

results.title: Skeleton Man
results.overview: Skater boys are terrorized by a delirious skeleton man at a strip mall pizzeria.

results.title: Peace 20 30
results.overview: On October 7th, Maoz Inon loses both of his parents and chooses to transform his grief into a struggle for peace.  He is joined on his journey by Aziz Abu-Sarah, a Palestinian from Jerusalem carrying his own loss. Together, they set an almost impossible goal: peace by 2030. In the face of war, pain, and despair, the film asks whether it is still possible to believe in a different future.

results.title: Where to Find Foxes
results.overview: A new mother, kept awake by the sound of foxes prowling outside her home, ventures into the night to scare them off only to find herself a part of a strange and feral ritual.

results.title: The Prince and the Kaiser – Yves Saint Laurent and Karl Lagerfeld
results.original_title: Der Prinz und der Kaiser – Yves Saint Laurent und Karl Lagerfeld
results.overview: At the International Wool Secretariat competition, 18-year-old Yves Saint Laurent and 21-year-old Karl Lagerfeld are honoured. Whilst Saint Laurent takes over Dior shortly afterwards and founds his own label, Lagerfeld becomes a master of constant reinvention. The former friends become bitter rivals, not least because of Jacques de Bascher, Lagerfeld’s flamboyant partner, who also comes dangerously close to Saint Laurent.

results.title: The House
results.overview: A teenager calls his friend over to talk about a reoccurring dream he has about a house.

results.title: The Prince of Seven Bridges
results.overview: An eccentric French opera singer living in St. Petersburg reaches the final round of a prestigious vocal competition at the Kremlin. But to gain recognition, he will have to do more than simply win: he must decide whether he is willing to trade his freedom for the conventions of the state-run cultural scene.
